title: Bhabho the Buffalo
summary: Bhabho the buffalo had beautiful horns. One day a bird drops a seed on her horn, and soon a tree is growing there. What will Bhabho do with a tree growing on her horns?
pages: Bhabho's horns got wet in the rain. The wind blew dirt and dust around, and it stuck to her horns. Bhabho didn't bother to clean them.
A few days later a bird was flying in the sky, and by accident it dropped a seed from its beak. The seed got stuck on Bhabho's horns. Bhabho hardly noticed the tiny seed.
Little by little the seed began to sprout and turned into a tiny seedling. Leaves began to grow on it.

In time the little seedling grew into a plant. Its branches began to spread out their arms. Everyone worried about Bhabho. But Bhabho didn't care. She kept wandering around and sitting wherever she liked, just as before.
When the sun blazed down, the other buffaloes got hot and cross and went looking for shade. But Bhabho didn't have to move a single leg. She would giggle and say, "Look, I have my very own umbrella!"
They couldn't help agreeing with her. After all, now Bhabho had a wonderful tree growing on her horns.

One day a bird decided to build her nest in Bhabho's tree. "Don't shake the tree, Bhabho," she warned the buffalo. "I've laid my eggs in it." Bhabho got annoyed. "But I need to look for food, don't I?" she asked.
The bird thought to herself, "Bhabho is right." She gathered all her bird friends and told them, "We need to bring Bhabho food, so she won't disturb our babies!"
Bhabho happily munched the food the birds brought her, and rested in the shade of her tree. What more could a buffalo want in life?

A tree on Bhabho's horns, leaves on the tree, a nest among the leaves, and two little eggs in the nest. What a strange sight! People would tell Bhabho she was far too lazy. But Bhabho didn't mind. "Is there any other buffalo here who does what I do?" she would ask.

Nobody had an answer to Bhabho's question. But everyone knew that one day the eggs would hatch, the chicks would grow up and finally fly away. And then Bhabho would at last have to get up and wander around looking for shade and food, just like all the other buffaloes. But Bhabho made a secret decision. She would stay sitting in her spot forever. Because Bhabho was not like any other buffalo.
